verdict.rationale: Metorial's own repo claims 1200+ integrations across SaaS tools, enterprise systems, data sources and custom MCP servers. The docs describe a catalog of pre-built integrations with OAuth for services like Slack, GitHub and Google Calendar. One community comparison says a competitor has more integrations, but it does not contradict the catalog's scale. missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of the catalog's size and breadth, first-party docs enumerating or browsing the full catalog

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform

citations.quote: 1200+ integrations across SaaS tools, enterprise systems, data sources, and custom MCP servers.
Beyond the pre-built integrations in the Metorial catalog, you can upload your own MCP server code and let Metorial host it.
OAuth lets your users authorize access to their accounts on services like Slack, GitHub, Google Calendar, and more.
